traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing the Shaka Era (78 CE) with the Vikrama Era (57 BCE). Kanishka started the Shaka Era.
Assuming Kanishka was a Buddhist from birth; he was a polytheistic ruler who later favored Buddhism.
Confusing Gandhara art (Graeco-Buddhist) with Mathura art (indigenous red sandstone).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in Purushapura (Peshawar).
  • Controlled strategic Silk Road routes.
  • Extended from Central Asia to Pataliputra.

Personalities

  • Ashvaghosha (Poet, Buddha Charita).
  • Vasumitra (Chairman of 4th Council).
  • Charaka (Physician).

Administration & Culture Mindmap

  • Economy: Issued first gold coins in India, control of Silk Route tolls.
  • Religion: Patron of Mahayana Buddhism, 4th Council at Kundalavana (Kashmir).
  • Art Schools:
    • Gandhara: Hellenistic influence, grey schist, focus on physical form.
    • Mathura: Red sandstone, focus on spiritual expression.
